claim_scope: Cost-closure ESTIMATES under named assumptions. NOT a measurement, NOT a gf180mcu feasibility result, NOT a fidelity/preset-quality/musical claim, and NOT a frozen profile. 'within_budget' is the only row shape that may carry a fit claim, and only as an estimate.

provenance.scheduler_contention_basis: SXT-016 publishes ONE scheduler record; its contention allowance is E1-referenced and is applied unchanged at E2/E3. That makes E2/E3 rows conservative on contention, and it is stated rather than silently re-derived.

verdict_semantics.NO_VERDICT_UNPRICED_COMPONENTS: nothing overflows, but unpriced components remain, so no fit claim may be made (plan section 5)
verdict_semantics.OVERFLOW_CONCLUSIVE: the probe-priced LOWER BOUND alone exceeds the DSP budget; pricing the unpriced components can only increase the cost, so this verdict is conclusive under the named assumptions
verdict_semantics.OVERFLOW_PLACEHOLDER_DEPENDENT: only the placeholder-mixed total exceeds the budget; a finding, not a conclusion (placeholders may be high or low)
verdict_semantics.within_budget: every component of the worst-case supported patch is probe-priced and the total closes at this clock and memory implementation
